the OS treats each element as a literal argument, not a shell command. cmd.extend(request.filter_flags.split()) # SECURITY: Set a timeout to prevent resource exhaustion (hanging processes) result = subprocess.run( cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=5 ) output = result.stdout #
